newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia noon rubber stable, eyes on rupiah.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia noon rubber stable, eyes on rupiah.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 prices were mostly stable in quiet noon trading on Monday, with players closely monitoring the rupiah after it plunged against the U.S. dollar, traders said.
"Players are closely watching the rupiah following the sharp decline this morning," one trader said.
The traders said local prices remained under pressure from Malaysia, where values were more competitive following the decline of the ringgit against the dollar.
"The comparatively lower prices in Malaysia are putting pressure on us to remain competitive," one trader said.
The traders said holidays in Japan and Thailand on Monday kept the local market quiet. "There have not been any enquiries or bids so far today because of the holidays," one said.
September shipment SIR20 offer prices were quoted at 44.00 cents/lb fob Medan and 43.50-43.75 cents fob Palembang. October shipment was quoted at 44.50 cents fob Medan.
